@CL_DC @basic_new_business_policy

Feature: GL Basic Policy
  As a Commercial Lines Duck Creek policy processing user
  I want to complete the GL Basic Policy workflow
  So that the business transaction is executed with source-traceable data and verification

  Background: Prepare Commercial Lines Duck Creek for policy processing
    Given I open a browser session
  Scenario Outline: GL Basic Policy - <stateCode>
    Given test data "<dataFile>" and external data "<externalDataFile>" are loaded
    And I open the configured Commercial Lines Duck Creek application
    And I sign in to Commercial Lines Duck Creek using configured credentials
    When I enter individual client information
    And I complete Underwriting Info from Client Screen
    And I complete required policy information
    And I complete CGL Fields
    And I add Class
    And I add [CG0435] Employee Benefits Liability Endorsement
    And I add [CG2142] Exclusion - Explosion, Collapse and Underground Property Damage Hazard (Specified Operations)
    And I add [CG 2149] Total Pollution Exclusion Endorsement
    And I verify and Fill out [FG0055] Employment Practices Liability Insurance Coverage Endorsement
    And I add Addl Interest [CG2007] - Engineers
    And I add Addl Interest [CG2020] Add'l Insured-Charitable Institution
    And I add Addl Interest [CG2023] Add'l Insured-Executors
    And I add Addl Interest [CG2025] Add'l Insured-Executive Officers
    And I add Addl Interest [CG2034] Add'l Insured-Leased Equipment Automatic
    And I add notepad comment
    And I switch to UW Director for OR and WA when required
    And I answer GL UW Questions OR & WA
    And I complete required billing information
    And I complete required submission information
    And I switch back to Agent for OR and WA when required
    And I run Stoplight
    And I verify values in premium fields
    And I complete forms verification
    And I sign out of the application

feature.name: GL Basic Policy
feature.description:
As a Commercial Lines Duck Creek policy processing user
  I want to complete the GL Basic Policy workflow
  So that the business transaction is executed with source-traceable data and verification

background.name: Prepare Commercial Lines Duck Creek for policy processing

steps.text: I open a browser session
test data "<dataFile>" and external data "<externalDataFile>" are loaded
I open the configured Commercial Lines Duck Creek application
I sign in to Commercial Lines Duck Creek using configured credentials
I enter individual client information
I complete Underwriting Info from Client Screen
I complete required policy information
I complete CGL Fields
I add Class
I add [CG0435] Employee Benefits Liability Endorsement
I add [CG2142] Exclusion - Explosion, Collapse and Underground Property Damage Hazard (Specified Operations)
I add [CG 2149] Total Pollution Exclusion Endorsement
I verify and Fill out [FG0055] Employment Practices Liability Insurance Coverage Endorsement
I add Addl Interest [CG2007] - Engineers
I add Addl Interest [CG2020] Add'l Insured-Charitable Institution
I add Addl Interest [CG2023] Add'l Insured-Executors
I add Addl Interest [CG2025] Add'l Insured-Executive Officers
I add Addl Interest [CG2034] Add'l Insured-Leased Equipment Automatic
I add notepad comment
I switch to UW Director for OR and WA when required
I answer GL UW Questions OR & WA
I complete required billing information
I complete required submission information
I switch back to Agent for OR and WA when required
I run Stoplight
I verify values in premium fields
I complete forms verification
I sign out of the application
